--- Fetch Commits ---

git fetch upstream && git log -1 --format=%B upstream/master | grep -q "^skip ci" || git merge upstream/master


--- Remove skip ci commits ---

git filter-branch --force --commit-filter '
  if git rev-parse --verify $GIT_COMMIT^{tree} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if git log -1 --pretty=%B $GIT_COMMIT | grep -q "^skip ci"; then
      skip_commit "$@"
    else
      git commit-tree "$@"
    fi
  fi
' -- master
